name: 多組方形圖文左右交錯，文字靠向圖片
desc: 多組圖文由上往下排列，圖片和文字每組左右交換；文字欄垂直置中，並靠向圖片那一側對齊。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。內容是多組圖文由上往下排列，每組左右兩欄，圖片和文字左右交錯：第一組圖片在左、文字在右，下一組圖片在右、文字在左，依此類推。圖片為方形，各組同一比例，約佔內容寬度的四成，明顯大於文字欄；文字欄約佔三成，相對圖片垂直置中，並靠向圖片那一側對齊：文字在右欄時靠左，在左欄時靠右。文字欄由上到下是標題（可多行）、說明文字，最下方是一個文字連結，連結旁附一個小圓形箭頭圖示，連結下方有一條約與連結同寬的短分隔線；標題上方可放小標籤，說明文字與連結可省略，沒有時省略，其他元素的位置不變。
mobile: 每組改為直向堆疊，保持原本的先後順序：圖片在左的組圖片在上、文字在下，圖片在右的組文字在上、圖片在下。圖片橫跨頁面內容寬度；文字的對齊方向不變，原本靠右的仍靠右。

en.name: Alternating square image and text pairs, text aligned toward the image
en.desc: Multiple image-and-text pairs stacked top to bottom, with the image and text swapping sides in each pair; the text column is vertically centered and aligned toward the image.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. The content is multiple image-and-text pairs arranged top to bottom, each in two columns, with the image and text alternating sides: the first pair has the image on the left and the text on the right, the next has the image on the right and the text on the left, and so on. The images are square, with the same proportions in every pair, taking about forty percent of the content width and clearly larger than the text column; the text column takes about thirty percent, is vertically centered against the image, and is aligned toward the image: aligned left when the text is in the right column, and aligned right when it is in the left column. From top to bottom the text column holds a title (may wrap to multiple lines), a description, and a text link at the bottom with a small circular arrow icon beside it and a short divider about as wide as the link below it; optionally place a label above the title; the description and link are optional; omit them when there is no content, without changing the position of the other elements.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the desktop layout.
en.mobile: Each pair becomes a vertical stack that keeps its original order: in pairs with the image on the left, the image is on top and the text below; in pairs with the image on the right, the text is on top and the image below. The images span the page content width; the text alignment is unchanged, so text that was aligned right stays aligned right.
